name: Admin user deleted an MFA phone from a user's account
description: Identifies an administrator removing a registered authentication phone method from an Entra ID account.
query:
AuditLogs
| where OperationName contains "authentication phone"
| where OperationName contains "Delete"
| project TimeGenerated, OperationName, Result, InitiatedBy, TargetResources

name: Email messages containing malicious URL deleted after delivery
description: Detects messages removed after delivery following retrospective URL analysis.
query:
EmailEvents
| where DeliveryAction in ("Soft delete", "Hard delete")
| join kind=inner EmailUrlInfo on NetworkMessageId
| project Timestamp, NetworkMessageId, SenderFromAddress, RecipientEmailAddress, DeliveryAction, Url

name: MFA rejected by user
description: Identifies sign-in attempts where a registered user explicitly denied an MFA request.
query:
SigninLogs
| where ResultType in ("500121", "50074")
| project TimeGenerated, UserPrincipalName, IPAddress, ResultType, LocationDetails

name: Rare and potentially high-risk Office operations
description: Identifies uncommon Office operations associated with mailbox persistence or collection activity.
query:
OfficeActivity
| where Operation in ("New-InboxRule", "Set-Mailbox", "Set-MailboxFolderPermission")
| summarize OperationCount=count() by UserId, Operation, ClientIP
| where OperationCount <= 2

name: Azure VM Run Command executing a unique PowerShell script
description: Detects uncommon PowerShell execution performed through Azure VM Run Command.
query:
AzureActivity
| where OperationNameValue contains "virtualMachines/runCommand"
| where ActivityStatusValue =~ "Success"
| project TimeGenerated, OperationNameValue, Caller, ActivityStatusValue

name: Outbound email exceeds 400
description: Identifies mailboxes sending more than 400 outbound messages during a one-hour period.
query:
EmailEvents
| summarize OutboundMessages=count() by SenderFromAddress, bin(Timestamp, 1h)
| where OutboundMessages > 400

name: Files copied to USB - blocked by policy
description: Surfaces file-copy attempts to removable storage that endpoint device control blocked.
query:
DeviceFileEvents
| where ActionType contains "RemovableMedia"
| where ActionType contains "Blocked"
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, ActionType, FileName, FolderPath

name: Guest users invited to tenant by new inviters
description: Detects guest invitations initiated by accounts that do not normally perform this operation.
query:
AuditLogs
| where OperationName contains "Invite external user"
| summarize Invitations=count() by tostring(InitiatedBy)
| where Invitations <= 2

name: High-volume SharePoint and OneDrive download
description: Detects an account downloading 50 or more files from SharePoint or OneDrive within one hour.
query:
CloudAppEvents
| where ActionType == "FileDownloaded"
| summarize DownloadCount=count() by AccountId, bin(Timestamp, 1h)
| where DownloadCount >= 50

name: Archive created in a suspicious temporary location
description: Detects archive creation beneath user or system temporary directories.
query:
DeviceFileEvents
| where ActionType == "FileCreated"
| where FolderPath contains "Temp"
| where FileName endswith ".zip" or FileName endswith ".7z"
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, FileName, FolderPath

name: Account created and deleted in a short timeframe
description: Detects cloud identities deleted shortly after their creation.
query:
AuditLogs
| where OperationName in ("Add user", "Delete user")
| summarize Operations=make_set(OperationName), FirstSeen=min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen=max(TimeGenerated) by tostring(TargetResources)
| where array_length(Operations) == 2 and LastSeen - FirstSeen < 1h

name: Sensitive file upload to external Teams user blocked
description: Surfaces DLP-blocked attempts to share sensitive files with external Teams participants.
query:
CloudAppEvents
| where ActionType contains "FileUploaded"
| where ObjectName contains "Blocked"
| project Timestamp, AccountId, ActionType, ObjectName, IPAddress

name: User added to Intune_Local_Admins Entra ID group
description: Detects membership changes that grant local administrator rights to managed endpoints.
query:
AuditLogs
| where OperationName contains "Add member to group"
| where tostring(TargetResources) contains "Intune_Local_Admins"
| project TimeGenerated, OperationName, Result, InitiatedBy, TargetResources

name: External guest downloaded sensitive archives
description: Detects archive downloads by guest identities from protected collaboration locations.
query:
CloudAppEvents
| where ActionType == "FileDownloaded"
| where AccountId contains "#EXT#" or AccountId endswith "external.example"
| where ObjectName endswith ".zip" or ObjectName endswith ".7z"
| project Timestamp, AccountId, ObjectName, IPAddress

name: Connection to a custom network indicator
description: Correlates endpoint network connections with indicators maintained in the threat-intelligence table.
query:
DeviceNetworkEvents
| join kind=inner ThreatIntelligenceIndicator on $left.RemoteIP == $right.NetworkIP
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, RemoteIP, RemoteUrl, ActionType, ThreatType, Description

name: Registry-based persistence references remote access tooling
description: Detects suspicious Run-key values associated with remote access tooling or masqueraded update binaries.
query:
DeviceRegistryEvents
| where RegistryKey contains @"CurrentVersion\Run"
| where RegistryValueData contains "SparkRAT" or RegistryValueData contains "svchost-update"
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, RegistryKey, RegistryValueName, RegistryValueData
